q1_issues.issue: The attributive modifier "algorithmically equivalent" is turned into a coined two-word binary head over the group's ordered pairs; the instruction set distributes a descriptive plural modifier as a property atom and licenses mutual-relation heads only for predicative symmetric predicates ("the senators are all colleagues").

q2_gaps: manner expressed as a quantified PP ("in three random ways"): Manner is defined for adverbs, and the preposition-named oblique is reserved for PPs that do NOT answer where/when/how, so a counted "in N ways" adjunct has no licensed route
an attributive relational adjective on a plural ("these algorithmically equivalent sequences") — relational/symmetric predicates are covered only in predicative position
notes: The two plural modifiers are handled inconsistently — "random" distributes as a property rule over PartOf, while "algorithmically equivalent" becomes a coined binary relation — and no per-member rule accompanies the group-level "can be defined" (a collective reading of this garbled sentence is defensible). Group witness, Cardinality 3, agentless-passive Theme and (Can e) are all as specified.
